record_scope_reconstruction: One abolished local ABL passage between Shamgona and Tagiloni. This is separate from the surviving Enguri Bridge route, not a closure of the whole Abkhazia boundary.

date_scope_check.qualification:
CC029-D1: Radio Atinati reports effective abolition on 15 April 2016, with consolidation at Enguri given as the official reason. The Public Defender confirmed the named closure in November 2017.

A DRI report covering September 2023–September 2024 again describes the named crossing as abolished and identifies Enguri and Pakhulani–Saberio as the remaining routes. Its reporting-period evidence supports a later closure status, but not an exact day of inspection, every intervening day of operation, or automatic extension to October 2026. Other routes remained available; exemptions at the abolished post are not established.
